primary_keyword: Nearest Hospital to a UK Postcode
title: Nearest Hospital to a UK Postcode
description: Find the Nearest Hospital to a UK Postcode with the dedicated finder — postcodes.io locates the centre, hospitals ranked by distance. Free.
summary_sentence: Results are limited to returned OpenStreetMap records and may omit closer or unmapped places. Confirm details with an authoritative local source.
quick_answer: The tool searches OpenStreetMap for mapped hospital records around a chosen location, then sorts returned records by straight-line distance. It requests at most 200 records and displays up to 100, so it cannot guarantee the closest result or a complete list. Data, access and opening status can be incomplete or outdated. In an emergency, contact local emergency services; this is not an emergency directory.

faq: postcodes.io returns a representative coordinate for the postcode. It may not match an individual property; calculated distances are straight-line approximations.
What should I do in an emergency?
Call 999. This finder supports planning, not emergencies.
Can I use the tool without sharing my precise location?
You can enter a postcode without using device location. The postcode is sent to postcodes.io and the selected coordinates are sent to Overpass.
Why might a boundary or place name look different elsewhere?
Hospital names follow NHS trusts and change with reorganisations; official NHS directories carry the current names first.
Does MapBench store my browser location?
Device location is optional, including on this page. The selected coordinates are sent to Overpass; consult the privacy page for details.
Not necessarily — community hospitals rank by distance like everyone. NHS.uk marks A&E departments; confirm there for emergency planning.
Check the postcode with an official source. A different postcode can change the location and ranking; do not substitute one for a critical decision.
UK-wide: postcodes.io covers the UK and OpenStreetMap records hospitals across all four nations.
The search selects hospital-tagged OSM records, not clinics as a separate category, and does not verify services. Check NHS or local official listings.
